items.title: RYANAIR AND AWS EXTEND AGREEMENT FOR ANOTHER 5 YEARS
items.summary: Ryanair, Europe’s No.1 airline, and Amazon Web Services (AWS) today (Mon, 27 July) announced that they have extended their longstanding collaboration for a further 5 years. items.title: RYANAIR ANNOUNCES PLANS FOR MAJOR SHANNON EXPANSION

items.title: RYANAIR WINS IRISH HIGH COURT RULING AGAINST EDREAMS
items.summary: HIGH COURT REJECTS EDREAMS’ ATTEMPT TO AVOID IRISH COURTS Ryanair, Europe’s No.1 airline, today (22 Jul) welcomed a High Court ruling rejecting Edreams’ challenge to the Irish courts’ jurisdiction, which now allows Ryanair’s case, to stop Edreams screenscraping Ryanair.com and overcharging customers, to proceed. items.title: RYANAIR LAUNCHES RECORD WINTER 2026 SCHEDULE WITH 80M SEATS ACROSS EUROPE
items.summary: Ryanair, Europe’s No.1 airline, today (16 Jul) launched a record schedule for Winter 2026, with 1,700 routes across 35 countries, including over 140 new routes. Ryanair’s record Winter 2026 schedule offers customers even more choice for their Winter 2026 getaways, including top winter sun destinations, ski trips, Christmas markets, or city escapes, at the lowest fares in Europe. Ryanair’s full Winter 2026 schedule is available to book now via the Ryanair App / website.
